# FT-RB-01 media readiness fixtures

Synthetic fixtures exercise only the absent-evidence path. They contain no asset,
rights, Product, supplier, Availability, price, stock, ETA/SLA, or runtime fact.

The focused suite dispatches 76 unique semantic mutations plus direct adversaries
for contract/source/owner drift, coordinated schema/registry drift, schema
keyword vacuity, wrong document types, duplicate keys, nonfinite values,
path/symlink/byte/depth/node limits, exact changed paths, live archaeology,
dependency pins, fixture-mode isolation, deterministic offline behavior, and the
C009 stable-ID collision regression.
